_metadata.description: Analysis of 11 'smaller' type-02 resources flagged for translation
_metadata.result: ALL SKIPPED - binary parameter data, not translatable text

0x803F_counts.R1054: present in final group (17864 glyphs of binary data)
0x803F_counts.R1358-R1367: present in final groups (11000-18000 glyphs of binary data)

evidence.structure: All follow identical pattern: header group G000, then N fixed 7-word parameter structs (XX00 0101 0000 0000 0001 0001 0000), then massive binary blob as final group
evidence.glyph_hit_rate_explanation: Reported 40-85% hit rates were inflated by 0x0000 and 0x0001 mapping to space characters in the glyph map. Actual meaningful text content is zero.
evidence.comparison: Known text resource R1196 has 0 occurrences of 0x803F and decodes to readable Japanese. These resources decode to gibberish.

notes: R760 and R788 do not exist as type-02 raw files
R1054/R1359/R1360/R1361/R1362 are nearly identical (36864 bytes, 12 groups each)
R1358 is slightly smaller variant (34816 bytes, 7 groups)
R1365/R1366 are identical structure (38912 bytes, 17 groups each)
R1367 has extra trailing binary groups (21 groups total)
R1055/R1065 are large parameter tables (174-164 KB, 169-864 groups)
